evidence: When they sell, the amount they get in return also rounds down. The problem is that repeated calls to `Launchpad::buy` (which all suffer from the rounding down issue), may be followed by a single call to `Launchpad::sell` which suffers a lesser effect from rounding. This results in a potential profit for an attacker. Also, it has the potential be cause the protocol to be frozen (for a specific token) in a situation where there are few `quoteReserves` in the curve, which could occur in the early stages of the token launch or if there are a lot of users selling back their tokens to the protocol. This is because on every call to `Launchpad::buy` or `Launchpad::sell` an event is emitted on Launc
